title: MiMo-V2.6-Flash-MOPD on two Sparks
evidence_scope: DFlash5 draft, MXFP8 MoE and safetensors draft loader, with two-node settings derived from the TP4 profile. On installer image dev-20260928-plainstatus-cuda1342-nccl2323-status033, an installation of these settings through install.sh on one pair, under the test profile ID mimo-v26-flash-rl-tp2, prefilled a 64K-token prompt at 2,806 tokens/s (performance/records/images/dev-20260928-plainstatus-mimo-v26-flash-mopd-tp2-20260928.md). On installer image dev-20261001-kraken-cuda1342-nccl2323-status034, an installation through install.sh on one pair passed 7 of 7 functional checks (counting, arithmetic, code, tool calls, image, thinking) and a 256-request correctness screen with no degenerate response, and decoded 39.8 / 130 / 195 tokens/s at 1 / 8 / 16 streams at temperature 1.0 with 64K-token prefill at 2,604 tokens/s (performance/records/images/dev-20261001-kraken-mimo-v26-flash-mopd-tp2-20261001.md); the lower prefill is unexplained. Single-run timing; not serving-qualified.
